items.title: Taylor has the numbers to topple Ley, his supporters say
items.description: Angus Taylor quit the Liberal frontbench yesterday ahead of a leadership spill expected to be called against Sussan Ley today.

items.title: Angus Taylor is making his move — but not on his terms
items.description: Angus Taylor was holidaying in Europe when his colleagues began manoeuvring to topple Sussan Ley. A leadership spill this week wasn't what he or Sussan Ley wanted.

items.title: The violent criminals and alleged killers behind alleged corruption at the CFMEU
items.description: Members of bikie gangs, convicted murderers and violent criminals are among more than 25 people who allegedly benefited from or are linked to corrupt behaviour at the CFMEU, according to a report.

items.title: PM 'not contemplating failure' as Closing the Gap deadline looms
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is bullish on closing the gap between Indigenous and non-Indigenous people ahead of handing down his annual report card on the progress made.

items.title: A look at Iran's non-negotiable ballistic missile program
items.description: Iran has spent decades building the largest and most diverse ballistic missile stockpile in the Middle East and is refusing US demands to put limits on the weapons program.

items.title: Live: Scotty James begins halfpipe campaign, Jakara Anthony crashes in final
items.description: Australia's defending champion Jakara Anthony finishes eighth after slipping during her second run of the women's moguls super final at the Winter Olympics. Follow live.

items.title: Possible El Niño within months raises potential for hot year across Australia
items.description: The first El Niño in three years could develop during the coming months, raising the possibility of worsening drought and extreme heat across Australia in 2026.

items.title: Old Bureau of Meteorology website still getting thousands of clicks
items.description: The new BOM website is still drawing criticism, with 400,000 users turning to the old site, despite $1.15 million in recent updates.

items.title: Australia's frozen ghost town leaves behind a toxic legacy
items.description: The ABC has been given rare access to an abandoned Australian base in Antarctica that continues to pose a threat to the environment.

items.title: Bougainville mine that sparked a civil war on rapid path to reopening
items.description: The Autonomous Bougainville Government signs a secretive deal to reopen a huge gold and copper mine that sparked a catastrophic civil war three decades ago.

items.title: Days before thousands of people crossed a new bridge, a 'large crack' was found
items.description: Days before the official opening, the Tasmanian government's largest-ever infrastructure project hit a hurdle, with a large crack picked up in one of the Bridgewater Bridge's piers detected and fixed, documents show.

items.title: China's president makes rare acknowledgement of corruption in army
items.description: Xi Jinping's comments were the first public admission of issues in China's armed forces since an investigation was launched into senior members of the body that overseas the country's military.

items.title: Thirty people stranded in outback NT express anger at police response
items.description: People caught on the western side of the usually dry Hugh River in outback NT are angry and disappointed about the lack of response from emergency services. The group of around 30 had limited supplies of food and water and were waiting for at least 24 hours before leaving the scene.

items.title: Fresh video shows police pushing protester before fight broke out
items.description: A new video filmed by a bystander and shared with ABC NEWS Verify shows the full minute before two police officers began punching a protester, shedding light on the beginning of the altercation.

items.title: A woman killed nine people in rare mass shooting in Canada. Here's what we know
items.description: Police confirmed the suspect was a woman but have yet to identify the victims of the mass shooting that left 10 people, including the alleged shooter, dead in the rural town.

items.title: US officials say cartel drones behind sudden closure of Texas airport
items.description: US officials say a sudden 10-day ban came into effect around El Paso International Airport after cartel drones from nearby Mexico breached American airspace.

items.title: Today's quiz is noice, it's different, it's unusual
items.description: It's an Aussie classic, but do you know who said these iconic lines in Kath & Kim?

items.title: Fatberg responsible for foul-smelling debris balls is 'inaccessible' for Sydney Water
items.description: The debris balls that have washed up on NSW beaches in recent years are likely to continue as Sydney Water admits a massive fatberg it cannot reach is clogging sewers.

items.title: Labor tries again on super taxes, but success will hinge on Greens support
items.description: A second attempt to raise taxes on high super balances has been presented to parliament, but will require the support of the Greens to secure Senate passage.

items.title: How Adelaide became a shining light for Saudi-backed golf
items.description: Saudi Arabia’s LIV Golf project is facing plenty of problems across the world, but you would not read about it when the circus flies into Adelaide.

items.title: Boy's Triple Zero call to save family swept out to sea released
items.description: Police release the recording of the Triple Zero call made by 13-year-old Austin Appelbee after his marathon 4 kilometre swim through rough seas to save his family.

items.title: 'Gimme more': Britney sells rights to music catalogue in reported $281m deal
items.description: Spears is the latest music star to sell the rights to their work, and comes a decade after the release of her ninth and last studio album.

items.title: Names of six 'powerful men' scrubbed from Epstein files revealed by US politician
items.description: US politician Ro Khanna has publicly named six men whose identities were scrubbed from the Epstein files, including the former boss of Victoria's Secret, who the FBI suspected was a co-conspirator of the sex offender's crimes.

items.title: Diamonds find 'identity' ahead of gold medal defence
items.description: Coach Stacey Marinkovich believes a refreshed Diamonds squad has found its "identity" ahead of attempting to become the first Australian netball team to defend Commonwealth Games gold.

items.title: Australia cruises to victory over Ireland in T20 World Cup opener
items.description: Australia beats Ireland by 67 runs to win its first game at the T20 World Cup, after captain Mitch Marsh was a late out due to testicular bleeding.
